description: This file defines a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes an array of cost records, grouping and aggregating them by specified dimensions ('environment' or 'cost_category') for visualization purposes (specifically for Recharts). It formats data into a structure suitable for creating grouped bar charts with consistent categories across agents.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a grouped dataset for visualization, with options for sorting and handling unknown categories.
